Going is a b-b-bad idea.|B2EMO to Cassian Andor|}} '''B2EMO''', also known as '''Bee-two''' or '''Bee''', was a [[B2 groundmech]] [[salvage assist unit]] who spent [[Standard year|years]] in the service of the [[Andor family]]. An old boxy [[droid]] with [[Color|red]] plating and a black main sensor, Bee could roll on his wheels over a range of terrains. He used his numerous tools to help members of the [[human]] family salvage scrap, and after the end of their scavenging days, he continued to serve as a helper and faithful companion to the family in [[Andor household|their home]] in [[Ferrix City]]. B2EMO's predictable life on [[Ferrix]] was disrupted by future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] operative [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]'s involvement in the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]], which brought [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] forces down on the [[planet]]. Bee projected a holographic message from [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]] at [[Maarva's funeral procession|her funeral procession]] calling on the people of Ferrix to fight the Empire. This launched the [[Ferrix Riot]] and forced him to flee the planet in the company of a group of Rebel sympathizers. B2EMO escaped to start a new life in a [[Council 436|farming settlement]] on the [[agriworld]] of [[Mina-Rau]]. ==Biography== ===Life as a salvager=== [[File:B2EMOdraggingsalvage-Reckoning.png|left|thumb|250px|A pristine B2EMO hauled the salvaged fuel nodules for the Andors on Kenari.]] B2EMO served [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]] and her husband [[Clem Andor]] in his primary function as a salvage assistant {{Andor|Reckoning (episode)}} by [[24 BBY]].{{SW|url=andor-s1-e3-trivia-gallery|text="Reckoning" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} establishes that the flashbacks in "[[Reckoning (episode)|Reckoning]]" happen prior to the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] and before the formation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], which was created two [[Standard year|years]] prior to the [[First Battle of Geonosis]] according to ''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'', which corresponds to [[24 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Therefore, the events of the flashback occur no later than [[24 BBY]]. Around that time, the three traveled to the [[planet]] [[Kenari]] to undertake a [[Exploratory mission to investigate a downed craft|salvage mission]] to retrieve unused [[fuel nodule]]s from a wrecked [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Transpo corsair|corsair]]. Before the humans boarded the wrecked vessel, Bee-two analyzed its atmosphere and found it safe to breathe. Clem, still nervous, wanted to leave as quickly as possible, but Maarva insisted they press on; for confirmation, she asked B2EMO the nodules' asking price. Before the droid could answer, the trio came upon the young orphan [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian]], scared and separated from [[Alpha (Kenari)|his tribe]]. At the same moment, B2EMO detected the approach of a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] frigate. Clem wanted to abandon Cassian and escape, but Maarva pointed out that the Republic military might kill him. She told Bee to give her a [[drowser]] that he was carrying. Maarva used it to sedate Cassian. She carried the boy back to [[Andor family hauler|their hauler]] while B2EMO followed behind, pulling the salvaged fuel nodules. Clem and Maarva brought Cassian back to their [[Andor household|home]] on the planet [[Ferrix]], where they raised him as their son. ===Farewell to Cassian=== By [[5 BBY]], Clem had been killed by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] troopers,{{Andor|Announcement}} but B2EMO still served Maarva and Cassian on [[Ferrix]]. By this time, Bee was showing his age in his faded and scratched exterior, his slower processing speed, and his need to recharge before performing certain functions. Still, he remained a beloved and trusted member of the family. Since he needed to spend hours recharging, he spent most of his time at home at Maarva's side. That year, Cassian traveled to the planet [[Morlana One]] to pursue his secret [[Search for Kerri|search for his sister]]. While there, he was accosted by two guards of [[Pre-Mor Authority Security Forces|Pre-Mor security]], and he fought and killed them. When Cassian returned to Ferrix, he called B2EMO, asking him to bring a wrap to treat his injured hand. Bee rolled through town early in the morning to deliver it, at one point using his [[electro-shock prod]] to drive away a [[Corellian hound]] that was trying to use the droid as a toilet. When Bee-two arrived, Cassian refused to tell him where he had been and furthermore instructed him to lie, saying if asked that he did not know where Cassian was and had not seen him. Since this would constitute two lies, B2EMO would need to go home to recharge. Bee missed Cassian and asked to come with him to wherever the human was going, but Cassian told him to go on home. Bee's lies were not enough to keep the incident on Morlana a secret. Pre-Mor Deputy Inspector [[Syril Karn]], obsessed with finding the person who killed the guards, had sent out a bulletin seeking information on a man from [[Kenari]] living on Ferrix—a description that would inevitably lead them to Cassian. B2EMO received the bulletin and repeated it to Cassian that evening, when he finally returned home to Bee and Maarva. Cassian decided that his best hope was to flee the planet without telling his mother, and he again enlisted Bee-two's help. Bee found it difficult to accept that his beloved human was leaving. Cassian gave the droid a [[comlink]] and told him about a stash of hidden [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to pass along to Maarva. Bee tried to convince Cassian not to leave, to no avail.{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} However, an [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team|inspection team]] from Pre-Mor security was already landing on Ferrix to begin their [[Ambush on Ferrix|search for Cassian]]. The team arrived at the Andor house not long after B2EMO. When the team's [[Sergeant]] [[Linus Mosk|Mosk]] found Bee in a back room, Karn began to question him, ordering his power supply to be cut as a form of intimidation. At that moment, Cassian hailed the droid over the comm, which everyone in the room could hear. Mosk was able to trace the direction of the signal and find Cassian's location. In the subsequent ambush, four corpo security troops were killed, and Cassian escaped. Maarva and Bee had to reckon with the idea that they might never see him again. ===Ferrix under occupation=== In the aftermath of Cassian's escape, the [[Galactic Empire]] took direct control of Ferrix. Not long after, Cassian returned home. He had been recruited into a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|Rebel team]] on the planet [[Aldhani]] that had [[Aldhani heist|stolen a huge supply of credits]] from the Empire. Bee had received a news bulletin about the heist and told Maarva, though they had no idea that Cassian had been involved. With his share, Cassian wanted to hide somewhere safe and comfortable with his family. Without revealing how he came by the money, he came to their house and tried to convince them to come with him. Maarva soon decided that she and Bee had to stay. Inspired by the news from Aldhani, she wanted to stay on Ferrix to fight the Empire in her own way. The family had no choice but to part ways once again. With Cassian gone, his friends [[Bix Caleen]] and [[Brasso]] became closely involved in Maarva and Bee's lives. The two younger humans came to their house to check on her health.{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} Meanwhile, both the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] and Rebel agent [[Cinta Kaz]] were staking out the house in the hope of finding Cassian—the ISB to capture him for his role in the Aldhani heist,{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}} Cinta to kill him because he knew too much about Rebel operations. They carefully observed Bee's movements in search of clues that could lead them to Cassian. ===A funeral and an uprising=== {{Quote|I don't w-w-want to be alone. I want to be with M-M-Maarva.|B2EMO|}} Some time later, Maarva died. Brasso came with [[Jezzi]] and some other members of Maarva's social club, the [[Daughters of Ferrix]], to clean out her house. B2EMO watched them, stunned and emotionally numb, and he began shaking so hard that a drink placed on his head nearly fell. Brasso tried to take care of the droid, suggesting he say goodbye to Maarva's body before it was removed from the house. Bee was afraid to be alone and wanted to leave with Brasso; he instead told the droid that he needed to stay behind to help the Daughters. After they left, Bee-two stayed for hours in his charging station, unwilling to leave the house or to accept that Maarva was really gone. Brasso, now responsible for the droid, wanted to bring him back home; he reluctantly agreed to stay in the Andor house for one night to keep Bee company. [[File:MaarvaAddressesProcession-Andor112.png|thumb|275px|B2EMO plays Maarva's call to rebellion.]] Days later, [[Ferrix City]] prepared for [[Maarva's funeral procession|Maarva Andor's funeral]]. The Daughters of Ferrix planned a large public ceremony for such a prominent local citizen and former club president, and B2EMO had the honor of leading the procession down [[Rix Road]] together with Brasso, who carried her [[Funerary stone|funerary brick]]. The Imperials, correctly predicting that Cassian would try to attend the funeral in secret, greatly increased their troop presence around the road to watch the funeral procession. Tensions were already high when B2EMO reached [[Fountain Square]] and played a fateful [[Holorecorder|holorecording]] that Maarva had made not long before she died. Her recording denounced the Empire, praised the spirit of Ferrix, and called for rebellion. B2EMO's recording threatened to subvert the Empire's rule on Ferrix, and [[Prefect (Galactic Empire)|Prefect]] [[Vanis Tigo]] tried to stifle it by covering the droid's projector with his cape and kicking him to the ground. But Maarva's words had already made their impact: the crowd began to physically attack the assembled troops, launching the [[Ferrix Riot]]. Ferrixian [[Wilmon Paak]] threw a powerful [[pipe bomb|homemade bomb]] at the troops; [[Stormtrooper]]s responded by firing their [[blaster]]s directly into the crowd. As Brasso helped Wil escape, Cassian's friend [[Pegla]] pulled the still-immobilized B2EMO to safety. B2EMO, Pegla, Brasso, Wil and Jezzi converged on the [[Zorby's Western Shiplot|shiplot]] where Pegla worked and hurriedly prepared a [[Breon HOY-39 Dayvan|Breon Dayvan]] starship to escape the planet. Cassian arrived with Bix—as the riot raged, he had helped her escape the [[Hotel Rix|Imperial headquarters]] where she was held captive. Cassian did not come onboard, but he promised Bee that he would join the group soon. ===Farm droid=== [[File:B2EMO-MinaRau-Andor-OneYearLater.png|thumb|250px|left|B2EMO waits for Cassian near the house they share on Mina-Rau.]] [[4 BBY|One year later]], B2EMO was helping to build a new life with Cassian, Brasso, Bix, and Wil in the grain fields of [[Mina-Rau]].{{Andor|One Year Later}} Bee befriended some other droids and children of their settlement, [[Council 436]], joining their games as they chased each other around.{{Andor|Harvest}} Cassian left the planet periodically on covert missions for the Rebellion, during which Bee would anxiously wait for his return. The little found family lacked legal permission to live and work on Mina-Rau. Their precarious status became dangerous when an [[Krole's contingent|Imperial force]] arrived to conduct a [[Imperial Supply Census|supply census]] while Cassian was caught off-world in a [[Yavin 4 turf war|fight between Rebel factions]].{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}} [[Kellen]], a local leader who operated a [[Mina-Rau General Store|general store]], knew about the friends' status and about Cassian's rebel activity. He did his best to help the humans evade the Imperial inspection and created a fraudulent [[Emergency Work Order]] to cover them in case they were caught on the run. They kept their preparations hidden from B2EMO because they knew he would panic if he knew they were leaving. Brasso entrusted him to his new romantic partner [[Talia (Mina-Rau)|Talia]], assuming that the Imperials would not scrutinize the droid. When Brasso went to say goodbye, Talia tried to reassure Bee, without much success. However, the escape went badly almost immediately. Stormtroopers caught Brasso and shot him while he tried to get away. Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Krole]] cornered Bix alone in their house, told her he knew about her undocumented status, and tried to extract sexual favors in return for his protection; when he tried to force himself on her, she fought back, killing him. Cassian returned to Mina-Rau in the midst of this violence and managed to get Bix and Wilmon into his ship and off the planet. Bee-two was left behind. ===New family=== {{Quote|G-g-go again. Once m-m-more and I win.|B2EMO to ARG19|}} [[File:Arg19-B2EMO-JedhaKyberErso.jpg|thumb|right|240px|B2EMO racing ARG19]] During the next three years, B2EMO remained on Mina-Rau while the three surviving Ferrixian humans became ever more involved in the Rebellion, eventually moving to the main [[Great Temple|Rebel base]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]].{{Andor|Messenger}} Bee-two continued to participate in the community and maintained friendships with both organics and droids, including his new best friend, [[ARG19]].{{Databank|arg19|ARG19}} In [[1 BBY]], Bix Caleen left the Rebellion, worried that her continued presence would prevent Cassian from serving the cause. She returned to Mina-Rau and reunited with B2EMO and Talia. Their family grew when she gave birth to [[Bix Caleen's child|her child]], her son with Cassian. ==Characteristics== {{Quote|I know it takes a lot of energy, but can you make a lie for me?''"
"''I can lie. I have adequate power reserves.|Cassian Andor and B2EMO|}} [[File:B2EMO-Maarva-Andor102.jpg|thumb|left|250px|B2EMO was a trusted companion of the Andors.]] B2EMO had a childlike personality, devoted and attached to the humans in his life and anxious when he had to be apart from them. Much of his life was centered on the Andors: Clem, Maarva, and Cassian. Cassian often departed from Bee-two, first to search for his sister, then to fight the Empire, or (in Maarva's words, which Bee repeated to him) "ruining your health and reputation with friends of low character." Every time Cassian did, Bee pleaded with him either to stay or to let the droid come with him. Maarva's death was a serious emotional blow, and after this, Brasso came to play a similar role in B2EMO's life. When the time came for Brasso to leave Bee, he was just as upset. Bee wanted to do whatever he could to help his people. He happily did favors to Cassian to help cover up his dealings. When he and Maarva were detained by the [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]] authority, B2EMO was prepared to lie and not give away Cassian's location. After Maarva died, Bee's impulse was to cling to Brasso and follow him to his work; the human convinced the droid to stay home by appealing to his sense of duty, telling him, "The Daughters of Ferrix require your assistance in matters of grave importance." B2EMO was an inquisitive droid, eager to learn about Cassian's activities and whereabouts. Long after he and Maarva stopped salvaging old ships, Bee remained an important source of information and news for her. He eagerly shared his opinions as well as information and often interrupted conversations to give his own point of view. In contrast to many other droids, B2EMO was treated as a valuable member of his family and community. He and Cassian had a close relationship, and the droid was capable of bantering with him. Cassian's attitude toward him was a mix of affection and frustration. The citizens of Ferrix gave him an honorable place in Maarva's funeral procession, and they were ready to rush to his aid when he was assaulted by an Imperial officer. He was particularly close with Brasso, who comforted the droid after Maarva's passing and stayed the night at their residence to keep the lonely droid company. By [[5 BBY]], Bee was noticeably weary, for a droid. He was experiencing malfunctions such as vocal stuttering, degraded power supply and data lags. ==Equipment== B2EMO was squat and boxy, a [[Color|red]] machine with black sensors who rolled from place to place on high-torque wheels. When fully charged, he had a powerful engine capable of hauling many kilograms of cargo. He was equipped with a range of tools for different purposes, such as atmospheric [[sensor]]s, a retractable storage tray, towing equipment, an [[electro-shock prod]] that could be used for self-defense, and a [[holoprojector]] capable of making a larger-than-life image. ==Behind the scenes== ===Origins=== {{Quote|The final design was a result of working very closely with animatronic designer Josh Lee throughout so there were never any unforeseen surprises. The final design is a complete product of my aesthetic and Josh's technical inputs.|Jake Lunt Davies|{{Twitter|JakeLuntDavies|status/1550614788119711746|[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2022-07-22|quote=Very. The final design was a result of working very closely with animatronic designer Josh Lee throughout so there were never any unforeseen surprises. The final design is a complete product of my aesthetic and Josh's technical inputs.|archivedate=20220724090645}}}} B2EMO was created for the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," the first episode, which was released on [[September 21]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} He returned for the show's [[Andor Season 2|second season]], which premiered on [[April 22]], [[2025]].{{Andor|One Year Later}} Writer [[Tony Gilroy]] wanted the [[Andor family]] to have a loyal companion: an ancient salvage droid who had worked with them for years. Gilroy conceived of B2EMO's character as that of an old family dog{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/star-wars-andor-b2emo-droid|text=Meet B2EMO, the adorable new salvage droid in Andor|author=Coggan, Devan|date=2022-09-14|archivedate=20220914154638}}{{SW|url=news/tony-gilroy-andor-season-1-interview|text=Tony Gilroy Breaks Down ''Andor'' Season 1}} and named the droid after his son's [[Wikipedia:Welsh Corgi|corgi]], Bemo.{{WebCite|url=https://www.laughingplace.com/disney-entertainment/atx-tv-fest-recap-star-wars-andor-tony-gilroy-beau-willimon|text="Andor" - How Disney's Biggest Creative Gamble Led to the Boldest Star Wars Story Ever Told|work=[https://www.laughingplace.com LaughingPlace.com]|date=2025-05-29|archivedate=20250531183822}} Composer [[Nicholas Britell]] created a musical signature for the character.{{WebCite|url=https://variety.com/2022/artisans/news/andor-composer-nicholas-britell-score-star-wars-1235383443|text=‘Andor' Composer Nicholas Britell Breaks Down His Score and Why He Incorporated Rustling Leaves|author=Burlingame, Jon|date=2022-09-26|work=[[Wikipedia:Variety (magazine)|''Variety'']]|archivedate=20220926170019}} [[File:B2EMOPropSDCC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|B2EMO was designed by Neal Scanlan and Jake Lunt Davies]] B2EMO's design was the work of creature designer [[Neal Scanlan]] and concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], who throughout the process worked closely with animatronic designer [[Josh Lee]] to ensure that the droid would translate properly from sketch to screen. Using the ''Andor'' script, the design team considered Bee's relationship with [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] and with the surrounding world, as well as the actions the story would require him to do.{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/gppr5wpqgb4t74974f8s|text=ANDOR Production Brief V3 FINAL 8-04-22|author=[[Gina McIntyre|McIntyre, Gina]]|date=2022-08-04}} The team quickly designed a squat, rectangular droid, only looking through a few drawings before picking what would become the final design. ===Design=== The team designed B2EMO to resemble a toolbox, with the droid's central carousel resembling trays from which instruments could be selected.{{InsiderCite|227|Creature Comforts (article)}} The droid's movements were designed so that small gestures and head movements could show recognizable emotions; for example, he had the ability to shrink down to show that he was sad or intimidated. [[Matt Denton]] wrote programming so that when the droid's body rotated, the head moved slightly as if through inertia. Similar programming was added to the droid's drive to create natural-looking movement. His wheels could be extended to allow him to move in an all-terrain mode. Gilroy and his collaborators loved the prototype when they first saw it at [[Pinewood Studios]], one of the filming locations for ''Andor''. The team built B2EMO from scratch, figuring out every detail including his square figure and red color. His exterior panels were attached magnetically and could be easily removed and replaced, allowing the same droid model to be used for flashbacks, when he looks shiny and new, and the main storyline, when he looks scratched and dented. ===Production=== {{Quote|B2 is quite complex. He has a whole kind of midsection which is essentially a carousel that can move tools around, up, down, left. His drive base has what we call omnidirectional wheels. In other words, multidirectional wheels; they can go in any pattern, his wheel base can change.|Neal Scanlan, on the complexity of B2EMO|{{BookCite|title=befores & afters|number=#33|date=2025-06-17|pages=p. 11|isbn=979-8287898458}}}} [[File:B2EMOARG19-Andor.png|250px|thumb|right|B2EMO (left) and ARG19 were fully controlled remotely]] Bee's movement was an entirely practical effect, controlled remotely. During filming, Bee had three operators: Matt Denton operated the drive, [[Josh Lee]] the carousel, and [[Dave Chapman]] the head, with [[Lee Towersey]] assisting in the performance. [[Diego Luna]], the actor who played Cassian, thought that acting alongside B2EMO was wonderful because the droid was real. This allowed for improvisation between droid and actor. B2EMO was also loved by [[Adria Arjona]], [[Kyle Soller]], and [[Denise Gough]], the actors who played [[Bix Caleen]], [[Syril Karn]], and [[Dedra Meero]], respectively.{{Twitter|starwars|status/1582800891706454016|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-10-19|quote=The cast of Andor shares their thoughts on the newest droid to join the galaxy, B2EMO.|archivedate=20221020141047}} Dave Chapman, who operated B2EMO's head, also read his lines during filming. The original plan was to cast an actor and rerecord B2EMO's lines. Tony Gilroy watched several audition pieces for the role before [[John Gilroy]], a film editor and Tony's brother, said he liked Chapman's performance better than any of the prospective actors. Tony agreed; they called Chapman and told him that he would voice the droid. ===Promotion=== B2EMO was first revealed to the public as an action figure for ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' to be sold exclusively at the [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic Con]] in July [[2022]].{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/star-wars-andor-hasbro-droid-figure-disney|text=Star Wars: Andor - Hasbro Figure Reveals a New Companion Droid|author=Zogbi, Emily|date=2022-07-13|work=[[Wikipedia:Comic Book Resources|''Comic Book Resources'']]|archivedate=20220721132452}} At that convention, the
